needs.premise: One managed marker, exact abstract key, processor-one owner, one closed GC view; admitted atomic root/list publication, complete descriptor, native owner/stop and view exclusion are premises; no C weak-memory execution or complete collector simulation
18 conditional declarations: bounded three-limb key injectivity, two-root/raw-key disjointness, admission/query Step/Trace, scan ordering and return gates; no complete QNT action or source simulation

Dedicated subtype candidate 16 with exact body size 2*wordBytes+24, two SCMOBJ cells then immutable raw key bytes; ordinary vector and FOREIGN are excluded representations; explicit scan case marks only cells zero and one; generated C and Scheme subtype tables, predicates, diagnostic walkers, size checks and module admission agree; candidate is not installed or globally ABI-certified

Immutable key is VM incarnation, activation slot and slot generation, each a bounded nonzero 64-bit component; all three decoded bytewise before protected registry lookup; no pointer identity, no wrap/reuse while any delayed observer can exist, exhaustion rejects; registry miss after managed classification is Closed, never legacy fallback; live original owner/thread and transport identity remain separate

Root explicit proc argument or frozen RC closure data before any allocation; pre-reserve root/control storage; private fully initialized still body starts raw refcount zero and mark -1; one no-safepoint/non-escaping publication gate commits still membership plus root enumeration before exposing marker; failure before commit retains inputs/private duty, unknown commit queries canonical service with backed roots; no unsafe public alloc_scmobj shortcut

Freeze all root-domain membership before all still-list setup, then global setup completion before root trace CAS, then typed body scan before strong/weak/sweep closure; enumerate every processor and constructor/quarantine root, including published but unclaimed views; still refcount zero does not eliminate explicit roots; root slot relocations are written back; no setup reset after any cross-processor mark

Replace direct marker VECTORELEM reads/writes, raw refcount operations, generic release and unchecked construction/subtype mutation for managed markers; preserve wrong-processor hook before closed-return error; guard CFUN/SFUN/kernel/setup frame consumers and global-state function table/module ABI; serialization or unsafe raw FFI exposure rejects managed cohort unless separately specified; no C sandbox claim

Captured frame keeps closed marker/key independently of activation metadata; permitted procedure clear never changes key or routing cell; release service root after view/object-borrow drain, but GC alone frees unreachable marker; no direct free at record retirement; drain/transfer VM root domain before unconditional cleanup still/RC; invalid raw pointer is never classified by dereference

C release/acquire or common lock covers input/root freeze, body/header/list/root commit and setup-before-mark; immutable fields still require lifetime-safe object borrow; registry lookup protects metadata before use; root slots cannot race relocation/clear; no atomics on a counter substitute for descriptor completeness or original-thread nonlocal jump legality

Only original owner arbiter commits a return through one activation control; queue/reserve is revocable and never grants direct C jump; closing and commit are mutually exclusive; consuming a committed return leaves live activation eligible for a fresh legal Scheme return, while duplicate transport receipt/old generation cannot repeat delivery

Clear marker only under valid root/heap write permit after published and claimed view obligations, object borrowers and prior writer drain, with new object-borrow admission closed at logical closing; do not hold permit while waiting for external borrower; unknown clear is replayable only as same false store with known stopped writer, valid shape and exact root-backed identity; no unknown decrement replay

Managed marker cohort uses typed allocation with raw initial still-refcount zero and canonical registered root pin before admission; root ledger owns one idempotent release receipt, never raw --; every raw refcount writer/reader and opaque access must reject or be migrated for that cohort; legacy initial-one bridge retains root/debt on unknown debit and cannot infer outcome from scalar count

Distinguish C activation right, object/root borrow, metadata reader and independent committed result custody; acquire metadata protection during registry lookup; managed discriminator/key remains lifetime-stable in captured marker after metadata removal, so managed missing identity rejects late return without stale pointer while legacy classification remains unchanged; drain all required pins before record/generation reuse, preserve captured continuation roots and already committed results; no root/credit refund from unknown legacy debit

Actual C race freedom and release/acquire/lock refinement for lookup+pin, activation reservation/return commit/closing control, backed handoff, phase-scoped marker clear, pin-ledger release and generation reuse; changing raw -- to atomic does not add per-operation identity or memory reclamation proof

nodes.labelText: Root proc / frozen closure data\nbefore any safepoint
Reserve root / control capacity\nprivate typed body, refcount0
Subtype candidate16\n2 SCMOBJ + 24 immutable raw bytes
Bounded publication gate\nvalid list + root entry together
Freeze all domains\nall still-list setup completes
Root enumeration -> still CAS\nscan exactly two root slots
Checked route + activation key\noriginal-owner delivery claim
Logical close -> permitted proc clear\nkey / route unchanged
Captured frame retains marker\nmetadata miss means Closed
Root/view/borrow drain\nGC reachability alone frees marker
Raw vector / counter / serialization\nreplace or reject admission
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource and C-order gates open

callers.actualChain: make_sfun_stack_marker calls make_vector then copies proc/RC data; source TODO warns procedure can move first
callers.hazard: Native C local is not an explicit root; data_rc is read only after allocation today
callers.replacement: Register proc or frozen closure data/code lease in root domain before any safepoint; typed constructor replaces vector for managed cohort

callers.actualChain: 5 subtype bits; 16/17 absent locally, byte-vector predicate uses 16<x
callers.hazard: Candidate 17 falls into byte-vector classification; candidate 16 default GC scan would treat raw bytes as roots
callers.replacement: Select candidate16 conditionally; generated shared tables, exact body descriptor, feature admission and full subtype consumer audit required

callers.actualChain: Generic allocator may GC, links still object, sets initial count1; caller fills body later; inline slow path decrements generic still result
callers.hazard: Changing initial count to0 without joint root/list gate exposes uninitialized or unrooted object; generic inline allocation cannot construct new marker
callers.replacement: Private allocation/accounting + valid header/body + pre-reserved root/list commit, zero raw count; no caller-filled generic new marker

callers.actualChain: Setup marks zero-count still -1; explicit mark_array CAS can enqueue regardless refcount
callers.hazard: Mark-before-late-setup is overwritten; duplicate/late setup can lose queued work
callers.replacement: Retain per-list setup ownership then all-list barrier, root enumeration, CAS queue and completion debt

callers.actualChain: FOREIGN skipped; ordinary default scans all body words; FRAME uses liveness map
callers.hazard: FOREIGN wrapper loses proc edge; default scans arbitrary key bytes as SCMOBJ
callers.replacement: Dedicated marker scan of body[0..1] only; reject wrong exact size/subtype and preserve relocation updates

callers.actualChain: mark_rc runs only P0 branch; setup and mark separated by real BARRIER
callers.hazard: Per-PSTATE root chain for processor1 cannot become VM-wide merely by reusing mark_rc name
callers.replacement: VM root-domain registry covers all admitted contexts, pending constructors and quarantine; distinct independent-worker task/view protocol

callers.actualChain: Kernel raw vector slot1 routes processor before slot0 false check; hook may migrate Scheme thread
callers.hazard: New representation cannot preserve raw offsets or equate processor id with native live owner
callers.replacement: Checked classifier/route then exact key original-owner claim, preserving hook/error ordering and Scheme semantics

callers.actualChain: Kernel raw temp3 vector0 feeds conversion handler; SFUN reuses same marker through error loop
callers.hazard: Missing raw read in migration loses error procedure or applies wrong one-return restriction
callers.replacement: Checked rooted procedure accessor; per-delivery identity; close only original activation guard exit

callers.actualChain: ___call stores marker in two-slot return frame, catches matching object only; ___run and generated SFUN create/kill
callers.hazard: Object equality currently matches native destination; serialized/copied key cannot create a live C frame
callers.replacement: Preserve frame GC-map marker slot and exact object match plus key/owner claim; no native-stack reification from key

callers.actualChain: kill false store then raw --; exports read/inc/dec fields without profile gate; release_scmobj decrements still
callers.hazard: Zero-count cohort raw decrement wraps or makes a nonzero seed; invalid memory cannot be checked safely
callers.replacement: Retire old kill/debit only for controlled cohort, profile-gate raw exports and generic release, require valid rooted handle

callers.actualChain: Binary serializer visits live continuation/frame slots; writer explodes continuation; unsafe subtype/vector mutators generated directly
callers.hazard: Copy/deserialize marker key is not authority; private raw subtype mutation can corrupt descriptor
callers.replacement: Explicit unsupported-live-native-marker serialization; opaque printing; reject or revoke raw access capability, no managed cohort for unaudited unsafe module

callers.actualChain: Sweep uses mark, teardown frees all still/RC; global-state ABI exposes marker create/kill
callers.hazard: Record removal is not object death; teardown defeats extra root or native reader
callers.replacement: Captured key persists after metadata; no direct free; root-domain drain/transfer before teardown, module feature admission required

callers.actualChain: c_closure_self global with thread-local TODO; alloc/register/data RC API has distinct native list and data field
callers.hazard: Reading mutable global after GC can select different callback and P0-only RC scan is insufficient
callers.replacement: Freeze actual trampoline closure/code borrow and root proc before allocation; reject foreign-thread/unqualified alias path

callers.actualChain: Tcl command callback and dynamic function conversions instantiate real SFUN entry chains
callers.hazard: Native-library lifetime, deletion and continuation escape are not fixed by marker type
callers.replacement: Shared generated C service must carry root/activation/transport duties through each real callback; external ABI remains explicit admission gate
